requirements.quote:
A NewReno sender enters a recovery period when it detects the loss of
   a packet or when the ECN-CE count reported by its peer increases.
requirements.condition: A NewReno sender detects the loss of a packet while it is not already in a recovery period.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Remaining outside recovery after detecting the packet loss.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can induce packet loss and observe whether the sender transitions into recovery.

requirements.quote:
A NewReno sender enters a recovery period when it detects the loss of
   a packet or when the ECN-CE count reported by its peer increases.
requirements.condition: The ECN-CE count reported by the peer increases while the NewReno sender is not already in a recovery period.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Remaining outside recovery after the reported ECN-CE count increases.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can increase the peer-reported ECN-CE count and observe the sender's recovery state.

requirements.quote:
sender that is already in a recovery period stays in it and does not
   reenter it.
requirements.condition: The sender detects another recovery-triggering event while already in a recovery period.
requirements.required_behavior: Remain in the existing recovery period.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leave the existing recovery period solely because another recovery-triggering event occurred.
requirements.why_checkable: Recovery state can be observed before and after an additional loss or ECN trigger.

requirements.quote:
sender that is already in a recovery period stays in it and does not
   reenter it.
requirements.condition: The sender is already in a recovery period when another recovery-triggering event occurs.
requirements.required_behavior: Do not reenter or restart recovery.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Starting a new recovery period while the current recovery period is active.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can compare recovery-period identity or start state across repeated triggers.

requirements.quote:
On entering a recovery period, a sender MUST set the slow start
   threshold to half the value of the congestion window when loss is
   detected.
requirements.condition: The sender enters a recovery period after detecting loss.
requirements.required_behavior: Set the slow start threshold to one half of the congestion window value used at loss detection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Entering loss recovery without setting the slow start threshold to half of that congestion window value.
requirements.why_checkable: The congestion window and slow start threshold can be sampled at loss detection and recovery entry and compared numerically.

requirements.quote:
The congestion window MUST be set to the reduced value of
   the slow start threshold before exiting the recovery period.
requirements.condition: The sender is about to exit a recovery period.
requirements.required_behavior: Set the congestion window to the reduced slow start threshold value before the recovery period ends.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Exit recovery while the congestion window has not been set to the reduced slow start threshold value.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inspect both values immediately before the recovery-to-post-recovery transition.

requirements.quote:
Implementations MAY reduce the congestion window immediately upon
   entering a recovery period or use other mechanisms, such as
   Proportional Rate Reduction [PRR], to reduce the congestion window
   more gradually.
requirements.condition: An implementation selects how to reach the reduced congestion window during recovery.
requirements.required_behavior: The implementation may reduce the congestion window immediately or reduce it gradually using another mechanism.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: None; the statement grants implementation choice and imposes no independent mandatory strategy.
requirements.why_checkable: The reduction schedule is observable, but MAY does not require an implementation to support either strategy as a separate feature.

requirements.quote:
If the congestion window is reduced immediately, a
   single packet can be sent prior to reduction.
requirements.condition: The implementation uses immediate congestion-window reduction upon recovery entry.
requirements.required_behavior: Permit at most one packet to be sent before applying the reduction.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Sending more than one packet before applying an immediate congestion-window reduction.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet transmission and the congestion-window update can be ordered and counted at recovery entry.

requirements.quote:
Therefore, during a recovery period, the congestion
   window does not change in response to new losses or increases in the
   ECN-CE count.
requirements.condition: A new loss is detected during an active recovery period.
requirements.required_behavior: Keep the congestion window unchanged in response to that new loss.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Changing the congestion window because of the new loss during recovery.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inject an additional loss during recovery and compare the congestion window before and after it.

requirements.quote:
Therefore, during a recovery period, the congestion
   window does not change in response to new losses or increases in the
   ECN-CE count.
requirements.condition: The peer-reported ECN-CE count increases during an active recovery period.
requirements.required_behavior: Keep the congestion window unchanged in response to that ECN-CE count increase.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Changing the congestion window because of the ECN-CE count increase during recovery.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can report an increased ECN-CE count during recovery and compare the congestion window before and after it.

requirements.quote:
A recovery period ends and the sender enters congestion avoidance
   when a packet sent during the recovery period is acknowledged.
requirements.condition: A packet that was sent during the active recovery period is acknowledged.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Remain in the same recovery period after such a packet is acknowledged.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can track packet send time, acknowledgment, and the recovery-state transition.

requirements.quote:
A recovery period ends and the sender enters congestion avoidance
   when a packet sent during the recovery period is acknowledged.
requirements.condition: A packet that was sent during the active recovery period is acknowledged.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Transition to a non-congestion-avoidance state as the normal result of that acknowledgment.
requirements.why_checkable: The sender's congestion-control state can be observed after acknowledging a packet sent during recovery.
